name: UF-door-wooden-dungeon
note: Dungeon door: heavy wood + iron bands in a stone arch. unfake grid snap.  (sample: seed 4111)

form.subject: front view of a heavy wooden dungeon door with iron bands and a ring handle, set in a dark grey stone wall archway, the door fills the frame
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3)

sample_command: pixelmon 'front view of a heavy wooden dungeon door with iron bands and a ring handle, set in a dark grey stone wall archway, the door fills the frame' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3)' --out 64x96 --palette none --despeckle 1 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --no-sprite-suffix --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 4111
